properties.description: The lifecycle half of dec:defects-are-temporal-facts, exercised for the first time. #88 fixed the content store inventing a directory; this increment makes the lineage gate name dec:export-once-per-pr. Both facts get VALID_TO set here rather than being edited into past tense, so "was this ever broken, and when did it stop" stays answerable.
properties.name: Two defects found by USE are fixed and CLOSED on the record — the first time VALID_TO retires a defect instead of a prose "DONE" annotation (2026-08-07)
